description: This owner choice fixture bounds observation sharing with a close family (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $c:candidate %conditions $c.without-elision-except(fam).matches(rival)
%rule candidate {X [+T]} B
%rule rival {piece} B
%rule piece m | n
%rule m X [+T]
%rule n X [+T]
%rule fam m
